sources_considered.why: Primary documentation identifies multiple task domains and explains limits on generalizing to ordinary work. Its update history identifies the May 8 graph.
The original paper additionally describes general-reasoning tasks, but its original inventory is not substituted for the later TH1.1 inventory.
Useful version history, but the graph's own documentation directly addresses the disputed scope.

evidence_items.explanation: METR describes the TH1.1 graph's distribution as spanning three technical domains. That contradicts the exclusive wording under the ordinary, narrower meaning of software development.

evidence_items.locator: FAQ about whether an eight-hour horizon means AI can automate all jobs, third reason
evidence_items.explanation: METR explains that its task distribution omits important features of ordinary work. Together with the documented domain restrictions, this supports the narrower point that the graph is not a direct demonstration of general intelligence.
